Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 10
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Wednesday, Jeth 6, 2083
11:00 AM
Management Work
On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister and Home Minister Balendra Shah, Honourable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to present the "House of Representatives Member Election (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Present the "House of Representatives Member Election (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(c) Present a proposal seeking permission to present the "Voter List (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(d) Present the "Voter List (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: On behalf of the Prime Minister and Home Minister, the Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs presented proposals and bills related to the election of members of the House of Representatives and the voter list. Specifically, two amendment bills were presented.
